## History

Though not directly present, God was referenced by those mourning Matthew's sudden death after the bank failure. Mrs. Allan helped [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) process her grief by assuring her that God's plans for [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) were well and right, comforting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) with the thought that [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) was now happy.
